I'm working on `/scratch/lelarge/mathcomp-eulerian/psi_descent_v2.v`. I need to prove the RIGHT subtree case (goal 2) of the structural induction in `tree_structure_via_tree`.

The proof begins with these tactics that set up the 3 goals:
```coq
elim: t => [|l IHl x r IHr] Hv Hu i.
  by rewrite /tree_props /=; repeat split.
simpl in Hv.
set sl := mmtree_to_seq l in Hv Hu |- *.
set sr := mmtree_to_seq r in Hv Hu |- *.
set s := sl ++ x :: sr in Hv Hu |- *.
have [Hmm [Hvl Hvr]] := Hv.
have Huniq_l : uniq sl.
  by have : uniq (sl ++ x :: sr); [exact: Hu | rewrite cat_uniq => /andP[]].
have Huniq_r : uniq sr.
  have : uniq s by exact: Hu.
  by rewrite /s cat_uniq => /andP [_ /andP [_ /= /andP [_ ?]]].
have IHl' := IHl Hvl Huniq_l.
have IHr' := IHr Hvr Huniq_r.
have Hsz_s : size s = size sl + (size sr).+1
  by rewrite /s size_cat /=.
have Hs_ne : s <> [::] by rewrite /s; case: (sl) => [|??]; discriminate.
change (mmtree_to_seq (Node l x r)) with s.
case: (ltngtP i (size sl)) => [Hij | Hji | Heq_ij].
- admit. (* left case *)
```

Now you are at goal 2: `Hji : size sl < i |- tree_props i s`.

The approach mirrors the original proof in `psi_descent.v` (the `j < i` case around lines 549-757). The key steps:

1. Set `i' := i - size sl - 1` and `ds := drop (size sl).+1 s = sr`.
2. Use bridge lemmas to rewrite window_size, window_at, has_left_child from `s` to `sr`:
   - `ws_bridge_right Hmm Hji : window_size i s = window_size i' sr`
   - `wa_bridge_right Hmm Hji : window_at i s = window_at i' sr`
   - `hlc_bridge_right Hmm Hji : has_left_child i s = has_left_child i' sr`
3. For `nth` rewriting: `nth 0 s k` where k > size sl becomes `nth 0 sr (k - size sl - 1)`. Use `nth_cat` and arithmetic.
4. For `nth 0 s i.-1`:
   - If `i' > 0`: use `nth_drop` to show `nth 0 s i.-1 = nth 0 sr i'.-1`
   - If `i' = 0` (i.e., i = (size sl).+1): this is the P5 boundary case. The element at position i.-1 = size sl is the root x. This case needs special treatment like the original proof's boundary case.

5. Apply `IHr' i'` to get the 5 properties on `sr`, then translate.

The P5 (pre_window_extremum_R) boundary case where `i' = 0` is the hardest. In this case, `nth 0 s i.-1 = nth 0 s (size sl) = x` (the root), and we need to show x is less than min(window) or greater than max(window). This follows from the tree validity: x = min or max of the full sequence s, so x is either < all window elements or > all.

Look at the ORIGINAL proof in psi_descent.v lines 655-757 for the i' = 0 boundary case pattern. Use `notin_take_mm`, `nth_w_mm_pos`, `foldr_minn_le`, `foldr_maxn_ge`, `min_eq_nth_sort_0`, `max_eq_nth_sort_last`.

Use `rocq_start(file="psi_descent_v2.v", theorem="tree_structure_via_tree")` to start the session. Navigate to the right proof state and develop the right subtree case tactic by tactic.

Report the complete proof script for goal 2 only.

1	(* psi_descent_v2.v — Option A: Structural recursion on mmtree              *)
2	(* Replaces fuel-based strong induction with structural induction on the    *)
3	(* min-max tree, producing O(n) proof terms instead of O(3^n).             *)
4	(*                                                                          *)
5	(* Strategy: The 5 structural properties (tree_props) are proved by         *)
6	(* structural induction on `mmtree nat`. At each `Node l x r`, the         *)
7	(* in-order traversal is `sl ++ x :: sr`, and validity says                *)
8	(* `mm_pos s = size sl`. The cons-unfolding lemmas (window_size_cons etc.) *)
9	(* are applied once per node and hidden behind Opaque bridges.             *)
10	
11	From mathcomp Require Import all_ssreflect.
12	Require Import mmtree psi_core psi_comm.
13	
14	Set Implicit Arguments.
15	Unset Strict Implicit.
16	Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.
17	
18	(* ===== Descent predicate (unchanged) ======================================= *)
19	
20	Definition is_descent_seq (w : seq nat) (k : nat) : bool :=
21	  nth 0 w k > nth 0 w k.+1.
22	
23	Example is_descent_seq_ex :
24	  let w := [:: 3; 1; 4; 7; 5; 9; 2; 6] in
25	  [seq k <- iota 0 7 | is_descent_seq w k] = [:: 0; 3; 5].
26	Proof. by []. Qed.
27	
28	(* ===== has_left_child (unchanged from original) ============================ *)
29	
30	Fixpoint has_left_child_fuel (fuel : nat) (i : nat) (s : seq nat) : bool :=
31	  match fuel with
32	  | 0 => false
33	  | fuel'.+1 =>
34	      match s with
35	      | [::] => false
36	      | _ :: _ =>
37	          let j := mm_pos s in
38	          if i < j then has_left_child_fuel fuel' i (take j s)
39	          else if i == j then (0 < j)
40	          else has_left_child_fuel fuel' (i - j - 1) (drop j.+1 s)
41	      end
42	  end.
43	
44	Definition has_left_child (i : nat) (w : seq nat) : bool :=
45	  has_left_child_fuel (size w) i w.
46	
47	Lemma has_left_child_fuel_0 : forall fuel s,
48	  has_left_child_fuel fuel 0 s = false.
49	Proof.
50	elim=> [//|fuel IH] [//|a s0].
51	by simpl; case: ifP => Hlt; [apply: IH | case: ifP].
52	Qed.
53	
54	Lemma has_left_child_0 s : has_left_child 0 s = false.
55	Proof. exact: has_left_child_fuel_0. Qed.
56	
57	Lemma has_left_child_fuel_monotone fuel1 fuel2 i s :
58	  size s <= fuel1 -> fuel1 <= fuel2 ->
59	  has_left_child_fuel fuel2 i s = has_left_child_fuel fuel1 i s.
60	Proof.
61	elim: fuel1 fuel2 i s => [| f1 IH] f2 i s Hsz1 Hle.
62	  move: Hsz1; rewrite leqn0 => /nilP ->.
63	  by case: f2 Hle.
64	case: f2 Hle => // f2 Hle.
65	case: s Hsz1 => [// | a s0 Hsz1] /=.
66	set s := a :: s0.
67	have Hj : mm_pos s < size s by apply: mm_pos_lt.
68	set j := mm_pos s.
69	have Hj2 : j <= size s0 by rewrite -ltnS.
70	have Htake_sz : size (take j s) <= f1.
71	  rewrite size_take Hj.
72	  by apply: (leq_trans Hj2); rewrite -ltnS.
73	have Hdrop_sz : size (drop j s0) <= f1.
74	  rewrite size_drop.
75	  by apply: (leq_trans (leq_subr _ _)); rewrite -ltnS.
76	have Hle1 : f1 <= f2 by [].
77	case: ifP => _.
78	  by apply: IH.
79	case: ifP => _ //.
80	by apply: IH.
81	Qed.
82	
83	Lemma has_left_child_cons i a s0 :
84	  let s := a :: s0 in
85	  let j := mm_pos s in
86	  has_left_child i s =
87	    if i < j then has_left_child i (take j s)
88	    else if i == j then (0 < j)
89	    else has_left_child (i - j - 1) (drop j.+1 s).
90	Proof.
91	set s := a :: s0. set j := mm_pos s.
92	have Hj : j < size s by apply: mm_pos_lt.
93	have Hj2 : j <= size s0 by rewrite -ltnS.
94	have Htake_sz : size (take j s) <= size s0.
95	  by rewrite size_take Hj.
96	have Hdrop_sz : size (drop j s0) <= size s0.
97	  by rewrite size_drop; apply: leq_subr.
98	rewrite /has_left_child /= -/j.
99	case: ifP => _.
100	  abstract (apply: has_left_child_fuel_monotone => //).
101	case: ifP => _ //.
102	abstract (apply: has_left_child_fuel_monotone => //).
103	Qed.

106	  has_left_child 2 [:: 3; 1; 4; 7; 5; 9; 2; 6] = false.
107	Proof. by []. Qed.

110	  has_left_child 5 [:: 3; 1; 4; 7; 5; 9; 2; 6] = true.
111	Proof. by []. Qed.

113	Example rank_shift_interior_order_ex :
114	  let L := [:: 4; 7; 5] in
115	  (nth 0 L 1 > nth 0 L 2) = (nth 0 (rank_shift_seq L) 1 > nth 0 (rank_shift_seq L) 2).
116	Proof. by []. Qed.

118	(* ===== Tree validity ======================================================= *)
119	(* A tree is valid_mm if at each node, the root sits at the mm_pos           *)
120	(* position of the in-order traversal.                                       *)
121	
122	Fixpoint valid_mm (t : mmtree nat) : Prop :=
123	  match t with
124	  | Leaf => True
125	  | Node l x r =>
126	      mm_pos (mmtree_to_seq l ++ x :: mmtree_to_seq r) =
127	        size (mmtree_to_seq l) /\
128	      valid_mm l /\ valid_mm r
129	  end.

131	(* mmtree_of_seq_mm produces valid trees *)
132	Lemma valid_mm_build : forall s, valid_mm (mmtree_of_seq_mm s).
133	Proof.
134	rewrite /mmtree_of_seq_mm.
135	suff H : forall fuel s, size s <= fuel ->
136	  valid_mm (mmtree_of_seq_mm_fuel fuel s).
137	  by move=> s; apply: H.
138	elim=> [|fuel IH] s Hsz /=.
139	  by case: s Hsz.
140	case: s Hsz => [//|a s0 Hsz].
141	set s := a :: s0; set j := mm_pos s.
142	have Hj : j < size s by apply: mm_pos_lt.
143	set tl := mmtree_of_seq_mm_fuel fuel (take j s).
144	set tr := mmtree_of_seq_mm_fuel fuel (drop j.+1 s).
145	have Htl_sz : size (take j s) <= fuel.
146	  rewrite size_take Hj.
147	  by rewrite -ltnS; apply: (leq_trans Hj).
148	have Htr_sz : size (drop j.+1 s) <= fuel.
149	  rewrite size_drop.
150	  have : size s <= fuel.+1 by exact: Hsz.
151	  move: Hj; case: (size s) => // k Hk Hk1.
152	  rewrite subSS.
153	  have H1 : k - j <= k by exact: leq_subr.
154	  apply: leq_trans H1 _.
155	  by rewrite -ltnS.
156	have Htl_eq : mmtree_to_seq tl = take j s
157	  by apply: mmtree_of_seq_mm_fuel_correct.
158	have Htr_eq : mmtree_to_seq tr = drop j.+1 s
159	  by apply: mmtree_of_seq_mm_fuel_correct.
160	split; [|split].
161	- rewrite Htl_eq Htr_eq.
162	  have -> : take j s ++ nth 0 s j :: drop j.+1 s = s.
163	    by rewrite -[RHS](cat_take_drop j s) (drop_nth 0 Hj).
164	  by rewrite size_take Hj.
165	- exact: IH _ Htl_sz.
166	- exact: IH _ Htr_sz.
167	Qed.
168	#[global] Opaque valid_mm_build.

170	(* ===== Bridge lemmas ======================================================= *)
171	(* Each proved once via cons lemmas, then made Opaque. These are the only    *)
172	(* places where fuel_monotone appears; the structural induction proof        *)
173	(* never touches fuel.                                                       *)
174	
175	Section Bridges.
176	
177	Variables (sl sr : seq nat) (x : nat).
178	Let s := sl ++ x :: sr.
179	
180	Hypothesis Hmm : mm_pos s = size sl.
181	
182	(* -- take/drop simplification under mm_pos -- *)

324	Local Lemma pre_win_lt_max_eq
325	  i a s0
326	  (Hlc : 0 < mm_pos (a :: s0))
327	  (Heq_ij : i = mm_pos (a :: s0)) :
328	  nth 0 (a :: s0) i.-1 <
329	    nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i (a :: s0)))
330	          (window_size i (a :: s0)).-1.
331	Proof.
332	subst i.
333	set s := a :: s0; set j := mm_pos s.
334	have Hj : j < size s by apply: mm_pos_lt.
335	have Hs_ne : s <> [::] by discriminate.
336	have Hdrop_ne : drop j s <> [::].
337	  move=> Habs;
338	    have : size (drop j s) = 0 by rewrite Habs.
339	  by rewrite size_drop => /eqP;
340	     rewrite subn_eq0 leqNgt Hj.
341	have [Hno_min Hno_max] := notin_take_mm Hs_ne.
342	have Hmax_d := max_val_drop Hs_ne Hno_max Hj.
343	have Hmax_sort := max_eq_nth_sort_last Hdrop_ne.
344	have Hpred_lt : j.-1 < j by rewrite prednK.
345	have Hpred_in : nth 0 s j.-1 \in take j s.
346	  rewrite -(nth_take 0 Hpred_lt).
347	  by apply: mem_nth; rewrite size_take Hj.
348	have Hpred_le :
349	  nth 0 s j.-1 <= foldr maxn (head 0 s) (behead s).
350	  by apply: foldr_maxn_ge; apply: mem_nth;
351	     exact: ltn_trans Hpred_lt Hj.
352	have Hpred_ne :
353	  nth 0 s j.-1 != foldr maxn (head 0 s) (behead s).
354	  apply/negP => /eqP Heq.
355	  have : foldr maxn (head 0 s) (behead s)
356	    \in take j s by rewrite -Heq.
357	  by rewrite (negbTE Hno_max).
358	rewrite (window_at_cons j a s0)
359	  (window_size_cons j a s0) -/j ltnn eqxx.
360	rewrite -(size_drop j s) -Hmax_sort Hmax_d.
361	by rewrite ltn_neqAle Hpred_ne Hpred_le.
362	Qed.

365	  i a s0
366	  (Hlc : 0 < mm_pos (a :: s0))
367	  (Heq_ij : i = mm_pos (a :: s0)) :
368	  nth 0 (a :: s0) i.-1 >
369	    nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i (a :: s0))) 0.
370	Proof.
371	subst i.
372	set s := a :: s0; set j := mm_pos s.
373	have Hj : j < size s by apply: mm_pos_lt.
374	have Hs_ne : s <> [::] by discriminate.
375	have Hdrop_ne : drop j s <> [::].
376	  move=> Habs;
377	    have : size (drop j s) = 0 by rewrite Habs.
378	  by rewrite size_drop => /eqP;
379	     rewrite subn_eq0 leqNgt Hj.
380	have [Hno_min Hno_max] := notin_take_mm Hs_ne.
381	have Hmin_d := min_val_drop Hs_ne Hno_min Hj.
382	have Hmin_sort := min_eq_nth_sort_0 Hdrop_ne.
383	have Hpred_lt : j.-1 < j by rewrite prednK.
384	have Hpred_in : nth 0 s j.-1 \in take j s.
385	  rewrite -(nth_take 0 Hpred_lt).
386	  by apply: mem_nth; rewrite size_take Hj.
387	have Hpred_ge :
388	  foldr minn (head 0 s) (behead s)
389	    <= nth 0 s j.-1.
390	  by apply: foldr_minn_le; apply: mem_nth;
391	     exact: ltn_trans Hpred_lt Hj.
392	have Hpred_ne :
393	  nth 0 s j.-1 != foldr minn (head 0 s) (behead s).
394	  apply/negP => /eqP Heq.
395	  have : foldr minn (head 0 s) (behead s)
396	    \in take j s by rewrite -Heq.
397	  by rewrite (negbTE Hno_min).
398	rewrite (window_at_cons j a s0) -/j ltnn eqxx.

403	Local Lemma xone_desc_eq
404	  i a s0
405	  (Huniq : uniq (a :: s0))
406	  (Hlc : 0 < mm_pos (a :: s0))
407	  (Hws : 1 < size (a :: s0) - mm_pos (a :: s0))
408	  (Heq_ij : i = mm_pos (a :: s0)) :
409	  is_descent_seq (a :: s0) i.-1 (+)
410	  is_descent_seq (a :: s0) i.
411	Proof.
412	subst i.
413	set s := a :: s0; set j := mm_pos s.
414	have Hj : j < size s by apply: mm_pos_lt.
415	have Hs_ne : s <> [::] by discriminate.
416	have Hdrop_ne : drop j s <> [::].
417	  move=> Habs;
418	    have : size (drop j s) = 0 by rewrite Habs.
419	  by rewrite size_drop => /eqP;
420	     rewrite subn_eq0 leqNgt Hj.
421	have [Hno_min Hno_max] := notin_take_mm Hs_ne.
422	have Hnth := nth_w_mm_pos Hs_ne.
423	have Hpred_lt : j.-1 < j by rewrite prednK.
424	have Hpred_in : nth 0 s j.-1 \in take j s.
425	  rewrite -(nth_take 0 Hpred_lt).
426	  by apply: mem_nth; rewrite size_take Hj.
427	have Hj1_lt : j.+1 < size s.
428	  have : j + 2 <= size s
429	    by rewrite -(leq_subRL 2 (ltnW Hj)).
430	  by rewrite addn2.
431	have Hj1_in : nth 0 s j.+1 \in s
432	  by apply: mem_nth.
433	rewrite /is_descent_seq (prednK Hlc).
434	case: Hnth => Hval.
435	- have Hd_pred : nth 0 s j.-1 > nth 0 s j.
436	    rewrite Hval ltn_neqAle; apply/andP; split.
437	    + apply/negP => /eqP Heq.
438	      have Hin :
439	        foldr minn (head 0 s) (behead s)
440	          \in take j s by rewrite Heq.
441	      by rewrite Hin in Hno_min.
442	    + apply: foldr_minn_le. apply: mem_nth.
443	      exact: ltn_trans Hpred_lt Hj.
444	  have Hnd_j : ~~ (nth 0 s j > nth 0 s j.+1).
445	    rewrite -leqNgt Hval.
446	    apply: foldr_minn_le. exact: Hj1_in.
447	  by rewrite Hd_pred (negbTE Hnd_j).
448	- have Hnd_pred :
449	    ~~ (nth 0 s j.-1 > nth 0 s j).
450	    rewrite -leqNgt Hval.
451	    apply: foldr_maxn_ge. apply: mem_nth.
452	    exact: ltn_trans Hpred_lt Hj.
453	  have Hd_j : nth 0 s j > nth 0 s j.+1.
454	    rewrite Hval ltn_neqAle; apply/andP; split.
455	    + apply/negP => /eqP Heq.
456	      have Heq2 : nth 0 s j = nth 0 s j.+1
457	        by rewrite Hval -Heq.
458	      have : j == j.+1.
459	        by rewrite -(nth_uniq 0 Hj Hj1_lt Huniq)
460	           Heq2 eqxx.
461	      by rewrite eqn_leq ltnn andbF.
462	    + apply: foldr_maxn_ge. exact: Hj1_in.
463	  by rewrite (negbTE Hnd_pred) Hd_j.
464	Qed.

466	(* ===== tree_props definition (unchanged) =================================== *)
467	
468	Definition tree_props (i : nat) (w : seq nat) :=
469	  (i + window_size i w < size w ->
470	    (nth 0 w (i + window_size i w)
471	       < nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i w)) 0) \/
472	    (nth 0 w (i + window_size i w)
473	       > nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i w))
474	               (window_size i w).-1))
475	  /\
476	  (0 < i -> has_left_child i w ->
477	    1 < window_size i w ->
478	    head 0 (window_at i w) ==
479	      nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i w)) 0 ->
480	    nth 0 w i.-1 <
481	      nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i w))
482	            (window_size i w).-1)
483	  /\
484	  (0 < i -> has_left_child i w ->
485	    1 < window_size i w ->
486	    head 0 (window_at i w) ==
487	      nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i w))
488	            (window_size i w).-1 ->
489	    nth 0 w i.-1 >
490	      nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i w)) 0)
491	  /\
492	  (0 < i -> has_left_child i w ->
493	    1 < window_size i w ->
494	    is_descent_seq w i.-1 (+) is_descent_seq w i)
495	  /\
496	  (0 < i -> ~~ has_left_child i w ->
497	    1 < window_size i w ->
498	    (nth 0 w i.-1
499	       < nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i w)) 0) \/
500	    (nth 0 w i.-1
501	       > nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i w))
502	               (window_size i w).-1)).
503	
504	Lemma pred_sub_add i j :
505	  j < i -> 0 < i - j - 1 ->
506	  (i - j - 1).-1 + j.+1 = i.-1.
507	Proof.
508	move=> Hji Hi'0.
509	have : i - j - 1 + j.+1 = i
510	  by rewrite -subnDA addn1 subnK.
511	case: (i - j - 1) Hi'0 => [//|m'] _ Hm.
512	by rewrite addSn in Hm; rewrite /= -Hm.
513	Qed.

515	(* ===== THE STRUCTURAL INDUCTION PROOF ====================================== *)
516	(* This is the heart of Option A. We prove tree_props for any valid          *)
517	(* mmtree by structural induction. The proof term is O(n) because:          *)
518	(*   - Each node contributes O(1) work (bridge lemma + IH application)      *)
519	(*   - No fuel_monotone proofs are generated inline                         *)
520	(*   - Base cases reference opaque local lemmas                             *)
521	
522	Lemma tree_structure_via_tree t :
523	  valid_mm t -> uniq (mmtree_to_seq t) ->
524	  forall i, tree_props i (mmtree_to_seq t).
525	Proof.
526	elim: t => [|l IHl x r IHr] Hv Hu i.
527	(* --- Leaf: s = [::], all properties vacuous --- *)
528	  by rewrite /tree_props /=; repeat split.
529	(* --- Node l x r --- *)
530	simpl in Hv.
531	set sl := mmtree_to_seq l in Hv Hu |- *.
532	set sr := mmtree_to_seq r in Hv Hu |- *.
533	set s := sl ++ x :: sr in Hv Hu |- *.
534	have [Hmm [Hvl Hvr]] := Hv.
535	(* Extract uniq for subtrees *)
536	have Huniq_l : uniq sl.
537	  by have : uniq (sl ++ x :: sr);
538	     [exact: Hu | rewrite cat_uniq => /andP[]].
539	have Huniq_r : uniq sr.
540	  by have : uniq (sl ++ x :: sr);
541	     [exact: Hu | rewrite cat_uniq => /andP [_ /andP [_ ?]]].
542	(* IH for subtrees *)
543	have IHl' := IHl Hvl Huniq_l.
544	have IHr' := IHr Hvr Huniq_r.
545	(* Size facts *)
546	have Hsz_s : size s = size sl + 1 + size sr.
547	  by rewrite /s size_cat /= addnS addnA.
548	have Hs_ne : s <> [::].
549	  by rewrite /s; case: (sl) => [|??]; discriminate.
550	(* 3-way case split on i vs size sl *)
551	case: (ltngtP i (size sl)) => [Hij | Hji | Heq_ij].
552	(* ==== Case i < size sl: recurse on left subtree ==== *)
553	- have [P1l [P2l [P3l [P4l P5l]]]] := IHl' i.
554	  split; [|split; [|split; [|split]]].
555	  + (* P1: post-window extremum *)
556	    move=> Hpost.
557	    rewrite (wa_bridge_left Hmm Hij)
558	            (ws_bridge_left Hmm Hij) in Hpost *.
559	    have Hfit := window_fits_left Hs_ne Hij.
560	    rewrite (ws_bridge_left Hmm Hij) in Hfit.
561	    set ws_l := window_size i sl.
562	    case Hbnd : (i + ws_l < size sl).
563	    * (* Window fits inside left subtree *)
564	      have Hpost_l : i + ws_l < size sl := Hbnd.
565	      have := P1l Hpost_l.
566	      by rewrite nth_cat Hbnd.
567	    * (* Window reaches boundary: post-window element is x *)
568	      have Hfit2 : i + ws_l = size sl.
569	        move/negbT: Hbnd; rewrite -leqNgt => Hge.
570	        by apply/eqP; rewrite eqn_leq Hge Hfit.
571	      rewrite Hfit2.
572	      have Hnth_j := nth_w_mm_pos Hs_ne.
573	      set wa := window_at i sl.
574	      have Hsz_sl : size sl <= size s by rewrite Hsz_s leq_addr.
575	      have Hws_gt0 : 0 < ws_l.
576	        by apply: window_size_gt0; exact: Hij.
577	      have Hwa_ne : wa <> [::].
578	        move=> Hab; rewrite /wa /window_at in Hab.
579	        have := size_takel (n := ws_l) (s := drop i sl).
580	        rewrite Hab /= => Hsz0.
581	        by move: Hws_gt0; rewrite -[ws_l]Hsz0.
582	      have Hwa_sub : {subset wa <= sl}.
583	        move=> y; rewrite /wa /window_at => Hy.
584	        by exact: mem_take (mem_drop Hy).
585	      have [Hno_min Hno_max] := notin_take_mm Hs_ne.
586	      have Hmin_sort := min_eq_nth_sort_0 Hwa_ne.
587	      have Hmax_sort := max_eq_nth_sort_last Hwa_ne.
588	      rewrite nth_cat ltnn.
589	      case: Hnth_j; rewrite -/s Hmm => Hval.
590	      -- left; rewrite Hval -Hmin_sort.
591	         set minwa := foldr minn (head 0 wa) (behead wa).
592	         have Hminwa_in : minwa \in wa.
593	           by rewrite /minwa; case: (wa) Hwa_ne => [//|b t] _ /=;
594	              exact: min_in.
595	         have Hminwa_le :
596	           foldr minn (head 0 s) (behead s) <= minwa.
597	           apply: foldr_minn_le.
598	           by exact: mem_take (Hwa_sub _ Hminwa_in).
599	         have Hminwa_ne :
600	           foldr minn (head 0 s) (behead s) != minwa.
601	           apply/negP => /eqP Heq_v.
602	           have : foldr minn (head 0 s) (behead s) \in take (size sl) s
603	             by rewrite Heq_v take_mm_eq //; exact: Hwa_sub.
604	           by rewrite take_mm_eq // (negbTE Hno_min).
605	         by rewrite ltn_neqAle Hminwa_ne Hminwa_le.
606	      -- right.
607	         set maxwa := foldr maxn (head 0 wa) (behead wa).
608	         have Hmaxwa_in : maxwa \in wa.
609	           by rewrite /maxwa; case: (wa) Hwa_ne => [//|b t] _ /=;
610	              exact: max_in.
611	         have Hmaxwa_le :
612	           maxwa <= foldr maxn (head 0 s) (behead s).
613	           apply: foldr_maxn_ge.
614	           by exact: mem_take (Hwa_sub _ Hmaxwa_in).
615	         have Hmaxwa_ne :
616	           maxwa != foldr maxn (head 0 s) (behead s).
617	           apply/negP => /eqP Heq_v.
618	           have : foldr maxn (head 0 s) (behead s) \in take (size sl) s
619	             by rewrite -Heq_v take_mm_eq //; exact: Hwa_sub.
620	           by rewrite take_mm_eq // (negbTE Hno_max).
621	         have Hmaxwa_eq :
622	           nth 0 (sort leq wa) (ws_l.-1) = maxwa.
623	           have -> : ws_l.-1 = (size wa).-1
624	             by rewrite /wa /window_at size_takel //
625	                size_drop; apply: leq_sub2r; exact: ltnW.
626	           by rewrite -Hmax_sort.
627	         rewrite Hval Hmaxwa_eq.
628	         by rewrite ltn_neqAle Hmaxwa_ne Hmaxwa_le.
629	  + (* P2: pre-window lt max when min head *)
630	    move=> Hi0 Hlc Hws Hhead.
631	    rewrite (hlc_bridge_left Hmm Hij) in Hlc.
632	    rewrite (wa_bridge_left Hmm Hij) in Hws Hhead *.
633	    rewrite (ws_bridge_left Hmm Hij) in Hws *.
634	    have := P2l Hi0 Hlc Hws Hhead.
635	    by rewrite nth_cat (leq_ltn_trans (leq_pred _) Hij).
636	  + (* P3: pre-window gt min when max head *)
637	    move=> Hi0 Hlc Hws Hhead.
638	    rewrite (hlc_bridge_left Hmm Hij) in Hlc.
639	    rewrite (wa_bridge_left Hmm Hij) in Hws Hhead *.
640	    rewrite (ws_bridge_left Hmm Hij) in Hws *.
641	    have := P3l Hi0 Hlc Hws Hhead.
642	    by rewrite nth_cat (leq_ltn_trans (leq_pred _) Hij).
643	  + (* P4: exactly one descent LR *)
644	    move=> Hi0 Hlc Hws.
645	    rewrite (hlc_bridge_left Hmm Hij) in Hlc.
646	    rewrite (ws_bridge_left Hmm Hij) in Hws.
647	    have Hfit := window_fits_left Hs_ne Hij.
648	    rewrite (ws_bridge_left Hmm Hij) in Hfit.
649	    have Hi1_lt : i.+1 < size sl.
650	      suff : i + 2 <= size sl by rewrite addn2.
651	      by apply: leq_trans _ Hfit; rewrite leq_add2l.
652	    have Hpred_lt : i.-1 < size sl :=
653	      leq_ltn_trans (leq_pred _) Hij.
654	    have := P4l Hi0 Hlc Hws.
655	    rewrite /is_descent_seq (prednK Hi0).

1	(* psi_descent_v2.v — Option A: Structural recursion on mmtree              *)
2	(* Replaces fuel-based strong induction with structural induction on the    *)
3	(* min-max tree, producing O(n) proof terms instead of O(3^n).             *)
4	(*                                                                          *)
5	(* Strategy: The 5 structural properties (tree_props) are proved by         *)
6	(* structural induction on `mmtree nat`. At each `Node l x r`, the         *)
7	(* in-order traversal is `sl ++ x :: sr`, and validity says                *)
8	(* `mm_pos s = size sl`. The cons-unfolding lemmas (window_size_cons etc.) *)
9	(* are applied once per node and hidden behind Opaque bridges.             *)
10	
11	From mathcomp Require Import all_ssreflect.
12	Require Import mmtree psi_core psi_comm.
13	
14	Set Implicit Arguments.
15	Unset Strict Implicit.
16	Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.
17	
18	(* ===== Descent predicate (unchanged) ======================================= *)
19	
20	Definition is_descent_seq (w : seq nat) (k : nat) : bool :=
21	  nth 0 w k > nth 0 w k.+1.
22	
23	Example is_descent_seq_ex :
24	  let w := [:: 3; 1; 4; 7; 5; 9; 2; 6] in
25	  [seq k <- iota 0 7 | is_descent_seq w k] = [:: 0; 3; 5].
26	Proof. by []. Qed.
27	
28	(* ===== has_left_child (unchanged from original) ============================ *)
29	
30	Fixpoint has_left_child_fuel (fuel : nat) (i : nat) (s : seq nat) : bool :=
31	  match fuel with
32	  | 0 => false
33	  | fuel'.+1 =>
34	      match s with
35	      | [::] => false
36	      | _ :: _ =>
37	          let j := mm_pos s in
38	          if i < j then has_left_child_fuel fuel' i (take j s)
39	          else if i == j then (0 < j)
40	          else has_left_child_fuel fuel' (i - j - 1) (drop j.+1 s)
41	      end
42	  end.
43	
44	Definition has_left_child (i : nat) (w : seq nat) : bool :=
45	  has_left_child_fuel (size w) i w.
46	
47	Lemma has_left_child_fuel_0 : forall fuel s,
48	  has_left_child_fuel fuel 0 s = false.
49	Proof.
50	elim=> [//|fuel IH] [//|a s0].
51	by simpl; case: ifP => Hlt; [apply: IH | case: ifP].
52	Qed.
53	
54	Lemma has_left_child_0 s : has_left_child 0 s = false.
55	Proof. exact: has_left_child_fuel_0. Qed.
56	
57	Lemma has_left_child_fuel_monotone fuel1 fuel2 i s :
58	  size s <= fuel1 -> fuel1 <= fuel2 ->
59	  has_left_child_fuel fuel2 i s = has_left_child_fuel fuel1 i s.
60	Proof.
61	elim: fuel1 fuel2 i s => [| f1 IH] f2 i s Hsz1 Hle.
62	  move: Hsz1; rewrite leqn0 => /nilP ->.
63	  by case: f2 Hle.
64	case: f2 Hle => // f2 Hle.
65	case: s Hsz1 => [// | a s0 Hsz1] /=.
66	set s := a :: s0.
67	have Hj : mm_pos s < size s by apply: mm_pos_lt.
68	set j := mm_pos s.
69	have Hj2 : j <= size s0 by rewrite -ltnS.
70	have Htake_sz : size (take j s) <= f1.
71	  rewrite size_take Hj.
72	  by apply: (leq_trans Hj2); rewrite -ltnS.
73	have Hdrop_sz : size (drop j s0) <= f1.
74	  rewrite size_drop.
75	  by apply: (leq_trans (leq_subr _ _)); rewrite -ltnS.
76	have Hle1 : f1 <= f2 by [].
77	case: ifP => _.
78	  by apply: IH.
79	case: ifP => _ //.
80	by apply: IH.
81	Qed.
82	
83	Lemma has_left_child_cons i a s0 :
84	  let s := a :: s0 in
85	  let j := mm_pos s in
86	  has_left_child i s =
87	    if i < j then has_left_child i (take j s)
88	    else if i == j then (0 < j)
89	    else has_left_child (i - j - 1) (drop j.+1 s).
90	Proof.
91	set s := a :: s0. set j := mm_pos s.
92	have Hj : j < size s by apply: mm_pos_lt.
93	have Hj2 : j <= size s0 by rewrite -ltnS.
94	have Htake_sz : size (take j s) <= size s0.
95	  by rewrite size_take Hj.
96	have Hdrop_sz : size (drop j s0) <= size s0.
97	  by rewrite size_drop; apply: leq_subr.
98	rewrite /has_left_child /= -/j.
99	case: ifP => _.
100	  abstract (apply: has_left_child_fuel_monotone => //).
101	case: ifP => _ //.
102	abstract (apply: has_left_child_fuel_monotone => //).
103	Qed.
104	
105	Example has_left_child_false :
106	  has_left_child 2 [:: 3; 1; 4; 7; 5; 9; 2; 6] = false.
107	Proof. by []. Qed.
108	
109	Example has_left_child_true :
110	  has_left_child 5 [:: 3; 1; 4; 7; 5; 9; 2; 6] = true.
111	Proof. by []. Qed.
112	
113	Example rank_shift_interior_order_ex :
114	  let L := [:: 4; 7; 5] in
115	  (nth 0 L 1 > nth 0 L 2) = (nth 0 (rank_shift_seq L) 1 > nth 0 (rank_shift_seq L) 2).
116	Proof. by []. Qed.
117	
118	(* ===== Tree validity ======================================================= *)
119	(* A tree is valid_mm if at each node, the root sits at the mm_pos           *)
120	(* position of the in-order traversal.                                       *)
121	
122	Fixpoint valid_mm (t : mmtree nat) : Prop :=
123	  match t with
124	  | Leaf => True
125	  | Node l x r =>
126	      mm_pos (mmtree_to_seq l ++ x :: mmtree_to_seq r) =
127	        size (mmtree_to_seq l) /\
128	      valid_mm l /\ valid_mm r
129	  end.
130	
131	(* mmtree_of_seq_mm produces valid trees *)
132	Lemma valid_mm_build : forall s, valid_mm (mmtree_of_seq_mm s).
133	Proof.
134	rewrite /mmtree_of_seq_mm.
135	suff H : forall fuel s, size s <= fuel ->
136	  valid_mm (mmtree_of_seq_mm_fuel fuel s).
137	  by move=> s; apply: H.
138	elim=> [|fuel IH] s Hsz /=.
139	  by case: s Hsz.
140	case: s Hsz => [//|a s0 Hsz].
141	set s := a :: s0; set j := mm_pos s.
142	have Hj : j < size s by apply: mm_pos_lt.
143	set tl := mmtree_of_seq_mm_fuel fuel (take j s).
144	set tr := mmtree_of_seq_mm_fuel fuel (drop j.+1 s).
145	have Htl_sz : size (take j s) <= fuel.
146	  rewrite size_take Hj.
147	  by rewrite -ltnS; apply: (leq_trans Hj).
148	have Htr_sz : size (drop j.+1 s) <= fuel.
149	  rewrite size_drop.
150	  have : size s <= fuel.+1 by exact: Hsz.
151	  move: Hj; case: (size s) => // k Hk Hk1.
152	  rewrite subSS.
153	  have H1 : k - j <= k by exact: leq_subr.
154	  apply: leq_trans H1 _.
155	  by rewrite -ltnS.
156	have Htl_eq : mmtree_to_seq tl = take j s
157	  by apply: mmtree_of_seq_mm_fuel_correct.
158	have Htr_eq : mmtree_to_seq tr = drop j.+1 s
159	  by apply: mmtree_of_seq_mm_fuel_correct.
160	split; [|split].
161	- rewrite Htl_eq Htr_eq.
162	  have -> : take j s ++ nth 0 s j :: drop j.+1 s = s.
163	    by rewrite -[RHS](cat_take_drop j s) (drop_nth 0 Hj).
164	  by rewrite size_take Hj.
165	- exact: IH _ Htl_sz.
166	- exact: IH _ Htr_sz.
167	Qed.

170	(* ===== Bridge lemmas ======================================================= *)
171	(* Each proved once via cons lemmas, then made Opaque. These are the only    *)
172	(* places where fuel_monotone appears; the structural induction proof        *)
173	(* never touches fuel.                                                       *)

175	Section Bridges.
176	
177	Variables (sl sr : seq nat) (x : nat).
178	Let s := sl ++ x :: sr.
179	
180	Hypothesis Hmm : mm_pos s = size sl.
181	
182	(* -- take/drop simplification under mm_pos -- *)
183	
184	Lemma take_mm_eq : take (size sl) s = sl.
185	Proof. by rewrite /s take_cat ltnn subnn take0 cats0. Qed.
186	
187	Lemma drop_mm_eq : drop (size sl).+1 s = sr.
188	Proof.
189	rewrite /s drop_cat ltnNge leqnSn /=.
190	by rewrite subSn // subnn /= drop0.
191	Qed.
192	
193	(* -- window_size bridge -- *)
194	
195	Lemma ws_bridge_left i :
196	  i < size sl ->
197	  window_size i s = window_size i sl.
198	Proof.
199	move=> Hi.
200	have Hs_ne : s <> [::] by rewrite /s; case: (sl).
201	case Hs : s Hs_ne Hmm => [//|a s0] _ Hmm'.
202	rewrite (window_size_cons i a s0).
203	have -> : mm_pos (a :: s0) = size sl by rewrite -Hs.
204	by rewrite Hi -Hs take_mm_eq.
205	Qed.
206	
207	Lemma ws_bridge_root :
208	  window_size (size sl) s = size s - size sl.
209	Proof.
210	have Hs_ne : s <> [::] by rewrite /s; case: (sl).
211	case Hs : s Hs_ne Hmm => [//|a s0] _ Hmm'.
212	rewrite (window_size_cons (size sl) a s0).
213	have -> : mm_pos (a :: s0) = size sl by rewrite -Hs.
214	by rewrite ltnn eqxx.
215	Qed.
216	
217	Lemma ws_bridge_right i :
218	  size sl < i ->
219	  window_size i s = window_size (i - size sl - 1) sr.
220	Proof.
221	move=> Hi.
222	have Hs_ne : s <> [::] by rewrite /s; case: (sl).
223	case Hs : s Hs_ne Hmm => [//|a s0] _ Hmm'.
224	rewrite (window_size_cons i a s0).
225	have -> : mm_pos (a :: s0) = size sl by rewrite -Hs.
226	rewrite ltnNge (ltnW Hi) /= eq_sym (ltn_eqF Hi).
227	congr (window_size _ _).
228	have -> : drop (size sl) s0 = drop (size sl).+1 s by rewrite Hs.
229	exact: drop_mm_eq.
230	Qed.

232	(* -- window_at bridge -- *)
233	
234	Lemma wa_bridge_left i :
235	  i < size sl ->
236	  window_at i s = window_at i sl.
237	Proof.
238	move=> Hi.
239	have Hs_ne : s <> [::] by rewrite /s; case: (sl).
240	case Hs : s Hs_ne Hmm => [//|a s0] _ Hmm'.
241	rewrite (window_at_cons i a s0).
242	have -> : mm_pos (a :: s0) = size sl by rewrite -Hs.
243	by rewrite Hi -Hs take_mm_eq.
244	Qed.
245	
246	Lemma wa_bridge_root :
247	  window_at (size sl) s = drop (size sl) s.
248	Proof.
249	have Hs_ne : s <> [::] by rewrite /s; case: (sl).
250	case Hs : s Hs_ne Hmm => [//|a s0] _ Hmm'.
251	rewrite (window_at_cons (size sl) a s0).
252	have -> : mm_pos (a :: s0) = size sl by rewrite -Hs.
253	by rewrite ltnn eqxx.
254	Qed.
255	
256	Lemma wa_bridge_right i :
257	  size sl < i ->
258	  window_at i s = window_at (i - size sl - 1) sr.
259	Proof.
260	move=> Hi.
261	have Hs_ne : s <> [::] by rewrite /s; case: (sl).
262	case Hs : s Hs_ne Hmm => [//|a s0] _ Hmm'.
263	rewrite (window_at_cons i a s0).
264	have -> : mm_pos (a :: s0) = size sl by rewrite -Hs.
265	rewrite ltnNge (ltnW Hi) /= eq_sym (ltn_eqF Hi).
266	congr (window_at _ _).
267	have -> : drop (size sl) s0 = drop (size sl).+1 s by rewrite Hs.
268	exact: drop_mm_eq.
269	Qed.
270	
271	(* -- has_left_child bridge -- *)
272	
273	Lemma hlc_bridge_left i :
274	  i < size sl ->
275	  has_left_child i s = has_left_child i sl.
276	Proof.
277	move=> Hi.
278	have Hs_ne : s <> [::] by rewrite /s; case: (sl).
279	case Hs : s Hs_ne Hmm => [//|a s0] _ Hmm'.
280	rewrite (has_left_child_cons i a s0).
281	have -> : mm_pos (a :: s0) = size sl by rewrite -Hs.
282	by rewrite Hi -Hs take_mm_eq.
283	Qed.
284	
285	Lemma hlc_bridge_root :
286	  has_left_child (size sl) s = (0 < size sl).
287	Proof.
288	have Hs_ne : s <> [::] by rewrite /s; case: (sl).
289	case Hs : s Hs_ne Hmm => [//|a s0] _ Hmm'.
290	rewrite (has_left_child_cons (size sl) a s0).
291	have -> : mm_pos (a :: s0) = size sl by rewrite -Hs.
292	by rewrite ltnn eqxx.
293	Qed.
294	
295	Lemma hlc_bridge_right i :
296	  size sl < i ->
297	  has_left_child i s = has_left_child (i - size sl - 1) sr.
298	Proof.
299	move=> Hi.
300	have Hs_ne : s <> [::] by rewrite /s; case: (sl).
301	case Hs : s Hs_ne Hmm => [//|a s0] _ Hmm'.
302	rewrite (has_left_child_cons i a s0).
303	have -> : mm_pos (a :: s0) = size sl by rewrite -Hs.
304	rewrite ltnNge (ltnW Hi) /= eq_sym (ltn_eqF Hi).

306	have -> : drop (size sl) s0 = drop (size sl).+1 s by rewrite Hs.
307	exact: drop_mm_eq.

310	End Bridges.

312	(* Make all bridges opaque to prevent proof-term inlining *)
313	#[global] Opaque ws_bridge_left ws_bridge_root ws_bridge_right.
314	#[global] Opaque wa_bridge_left wa_bridge_root wa_bridge_right.
315	#[global] Opaque hlc_bridge_left hlc_bridge_root hlc_bridge_right.
316	#[global] Opaque take_mm_eq drop_mm_eq.

318	(* ===== Base-case lemmas for i = root ======================================= *)
319	
320	(* These are the non-trivial base cases when i equals the root position.     *)
321	(* They are proved separately and made Opaque to keep the structural         *)
322	(* induction proof's term small.                                             *)
323	
324	Local Lemma pre_win_lt_max_eq
325	  i a s0
326	  (Hlc : 0 < mm_pos (a :: s0))
327	  (Heq_ij : i = mm_pos (a :: s0)) :
328	  nth 0 (a :: s0) i.-1 <
329	    nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i (a :: s0)))
330	          (window_size i (a :: s0)).-1.
331	Proof.
332	subst i.
333	set s := a :: s0; set j := mm_pos s.
334	have Hj : j < size s by apply: mm_pos_lt.
335	have Hs_ne : s <> [::] by discriminate.
336	have Hdrop_ne : drop j s <> [::].
337	  move=> Habs;
338	    have : size (drop j s) = 0 by rewrite Habs.
339	  by rewrite size_drop => /eqP;
340	     rewrite subn_eq0 leqNgt Hj.
341	have [Hno_min Hno_max] := notin_take_mm Hs_ne.
342	have Hmax_d := max_val_drop Hs_ne Hno_max Hj.
343	have Hmax_sort := max_eq_nth_sort_last Hdrop_ne.
344	have Hpred_lt : j.-1 < j by rewrite prednK.
345	have Hpred_in : nth 0 s j.-1 \in take j s.
346	  rewrite -(nth_take 0 Hpred_lt).
347	  by apply: mem_nth; rewrite size_take Hj.
348	have Hpred_le :
349	  nth 0 s j.-1 <= foldr maxn (head 0 s) (behead s).
350	  by apply: foldr_maxn_ge; apply: mem_nth;
351	     exact: ltn_trans Hpred_lt Hj.
352	have Hpred_ne :
353	  nth 0 s j.-1 != foldr maxn (head 0 s) (behead s).
354	  apply/negP => /eqP Heq.
355	  have : foldr maxn (head 0 s) (behead s)
356	    \in take j s by rewrite -Heq.
357	  by rewrite (negbTE Hno_max).
358	rewrite (window_at_cons j a s0)
359	  (window_size_cons j a s0) -/j ltnn eqxx.
360	rewrite -(size_drop j s) -Hmax_sort Hmax_d.
361	by rewrite ltn_neqAle Hpred_ne Hpred_le.
362	Qed.
363	
364	Local Lemma pre_win_gt_min_eq
365	  i a s0
366	  (Hlc : 0 < mm_pos (a :: s0))
367	  (Heq_ij : i = mm_pos (a :: s0)) :
368	  nth 0 (a :: s0) i.-1 >
369	    nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i (a :: s0))) 0.
370	Proof.
371	subst i.
372	set s := a :: s0; set j := mm_pos s.
373	have Hj : j < size s by apply: mm_pos_lt.
374	have Hs_ne : s <> [::] by discriminate.
375	have Hdrop_ne : drop j s <> [::].
376	  move=> Habs;
377	    have : size (drop j s) = 0 by rewrite Habs.
378	  by rewrite size_drop => /eqP;
379	     rewrite subn_eq0 leqNgt Hj.
380	have [Hno_min Hno_max] := notin_take_mm Hs_ne.
381	have Hmin_d := min_val_drop Hs_ne Hno_min Hj.
382	have Hmin_sort := min_eq_nth_sort_0 Hdrop_ne.
383	have Hpred_lt : j.-1 < j by rewrite prednK.
384	have Hpred_in : nth 0 s j.-1 \in take j s.
385	  rewrite -(nth_take 0 Hpred_lt).
386	  by apply: mem_nth; rewrite size_take Hj.
387	have Hpred_ge :
388	  foldr minn (head 0 s) (behead s)
389	    <= nth 0 s j.-1.
390	  by apply: foldr_minn_le; apply: mem_nth;
391	     exact: ltn_trans Hpred_lt Hj.
392	have Hpred_ne :
393	  nth 0 s j.-1 != foldr minn (head 0 s) (behead s).
394	  apply/negP => /eqP Heq.
395	  have : foldr minn (head 0 s) (behead s)
396	    \in take j s by rewrite -Heq.
397	  by rewrite (negbTE Hno_min).
398	rewrite (window_at_cons j a s0) -/j ltnn eqxx.
399	rewrite -Hmin_sort Hmin_d.
400	by rewrite ltn_neqAle eq_sym Hpred_ne Hpred_ge.
401	Qed.

403	Local Lemma xone_desc_eq
404	  i a s0
405	  (Huniq : uniq (a :: s0))
406	  (Hlc : 0 < mm_pos (a :: s0))
407	  (Hws : 1 < size (a :: s0) - mm_pos (a :: s0))
408	  (Heq_ij : i = mm_pos (a :: s0)) :
409	  is_descent_seq (a :: s0) i.-1 (+)
410	  is_descent_seq (a :: s0) i.
411	Proof.
412	subst i.
413	set s := a :: s0; set j := mm_pos s.
414	have Hj : j < size s by apply: mm_pos_lt.
415	have Hs_ne : s <> [::] by discriminate.
416	have Hdrop_ne : drop j s <> [::].
417	  move=> Habs;
418	    have : size (drop j s) = 0 by rewrite Habs.
419	  by rewrite size_drop => /eqP;
420	     rewrite subn_eq0 leqNgt Hj.
421	have [Hno_min Hno_max] := notin_take_mm Hs_ne.
422	have Hnth := nth_w_mm_pos Hs_ne.
423	have Hpred_lt : j.-1 < j by rewrite prednK.
424	have Hpred_in : nth 0 s j.-1 \in take j s.
425	  rewrite -(nth_take 0 Hpred_lt).
426	  by apply: mem_nth; rewrite size_take Hj.
427	have Hj1_lt : j.+1 < size s.
428	  have : j + 2 <= size s
429	    by rewrite -(leq_subRL 2 (ltnW Hj)).
430	  by rewrite addn2.
431	have Hj1_in : nth 0 s j.+1 \in s
432	  by apply: mem_nth.
433	rewrite /is_descent_seq (prednK Hlc).
434	case: Hnth => Hval.
435	- have Hd_pred : nth 0 s j.-1 > nth 0 s j.
436	    rewrite Hval ltn_neqAle; apply/andP; split.
437	    + apply/negP => /eqP Heq.
438	      have Hin :
439	        foldr minn (head 0 s) (behead s)
440	          \in take j s by rewrite Heq.
441	      by rewrite Hin in Hno_min.
442	    + apply: foldr_minn_le. apply: mem_nth.
443	      exact: ltn_trans Hpred_lt Hj.
444	  have Hnd_j : ~~ (nth 0 s j > nth 0 s j.+1).
445	    rewrite -leqNgt Hval.
446	    apply: foldr_minn_le. exact: Hj1_in.
447	  by rewrite Hd_pred (negbTE Hnd_j).
448	- have Hnd_pred :
449	    ~~ (nth 0 s j.-1 > nth 0 s j).
450	    rewrite -leqNgt Hval.
451	    apply: foldr_maxn_ge. apply: mem_nth.
452	    exact: ltn_trans Hpred_lt Hj.
453	  have Hd_j : nth 0 s j > nth 0 s j.+1.
454	    rewrite Hval ltn_neqAle; apply/andP; split.
455	    + apply/negP => /eqP Heq.
456	      have Heq2 : nth 0 s j = nth 0 s j.+1
457	        by rewrite Hval -Heq.
458	      have : j == j.+1.
459	        by rewrite -(nth_uniq 0 Hj Hj1_lt Huniq)
460	           Heq2 eqxx.
461	      by rewrite eqn_leq ltnn andbF.
462	    + apply: foldr_maxn_ge. exact: Hj1_in.
463	  by rewrite (negbTE Hnd_pred) Hd_j.
464	Qed.

466	(* ===== tree_props definition (unchanged) =================================== *)
467	
468	Definition tree_props (i : nat) (w : seq nat) :=
469	  (i + window_size i w < size w ->
470	    (nth 0 w (i + window_size i w)
471	       < nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i w)) 0) \/
472	    (nth 0 w (i + window_size i w)
473	       > nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i w))
474	               (window_size i w).-1))
475	  /\
476	  (0 < i -> has_left_child i w ->
477	    1 < window_size i w ->
478	    head 0 (window_at i w) ==
479	      nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i w)) 0 ->
480	    nth 0 w i.-1 <
481	      nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i w))
482	            (window_size i w).-1)
483	  /\
484	  (0 < i -> has_left_child i w ->
485	    1 < window_size i w ->
486	    head 0 (window_at i w) ==
487	      nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i w))
488	            (window_size i w).-1 ->
489	    nth 0 w i.-1 >
490	      nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i w)) 0)
491	  /\
492	  (0 < i -> has_left_child i w ->
493	    1 < window_size i w ->
494	    is_descent_seq w i.-1 (+) is_descent_seq w i)
495	  /\
496	  (0 < i -> ~~ has_left_child i w ->
497	    1 < window_size i w ->
498	    (nth 0 w i.-1
499	       < nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i w)) 0) \/
500	    (nth 0 w i.-1
501	       > nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i w))
502	               (window_size i w).-1)).
503	
504	Lemma pred_sub_add i j :
505	  j < i -> 0 < i - j - 1 ->
506	  (i - j - 1).-1 + j.+1 = i.-1.
507	Proof.
508	move=> Hji Hi'0.
509	have : i - j - 1 + j.+1 = i
510	  by rewrite -subnDA addn1 subnK.
511	case: (i - j - 1) Hi'0 => [//|m'] _ Hm.
512	by rewrite addSn in Hm; rewrite /= -Hm.
513	Qed.
514	
515	(* ===== THE STRUCTURAL INDUCTION PROOF ====================================== *)
516	(* This is the heart of Option A. We prove tree_props for any valid          *)
517	(* mmtree by structural induction. The proof term is O(n) because:          *)
518	(*   - Each node contributes O(1) work (bridge lemma + IH application)      *)
519	(*   - No fuel_monotone proofs are generated inline                         *)
520	(*   - Base cases reference opaque local lemmas                             *)
521	
522	Lemma tree_structure_via_tree t :
523	  valid_mm t -> uniq (mmtree_to_seq t) ->
524	  forall i, tree_props i (mmtree_to_seq t).
525	Proof.
526	elim: t => [|l IHl x r IHr] Hv Hu i.
527	(* --- Leaf: s = [::], all properties vacuous --- *)
528	  by rewrite /tree_props /=; repeat split.
529	(* --- Node l x r --- *)
530	simpl in Hv.
531	set sl := mmtree_to_seq l in Hv Hu |- *.
532	set sr := mmtree_to_seq r in Hv Hu |- *.
533	set s := sl ++ x :: sr in Hv Hu |- *.
534	have [Hmm [Hvl Hvr]] := Hv.
535	(* Extract uniq for subtrees *)
536	have Huniq_l : uniq sl.
537	  by have : uniq (sl ++ x :: sr);
538	     [exact: Hu | rewrite cat_uniq => /andP[]].
539	have Huniq_r : uniq sr.
540	  have : uniq (sl ++ x :: sr) by exact: Hu.
541	  rewrite cat_uniq => /andP [_ /andP [_ /=]].
542	  by rewrite andbC => /andP [? _].
543	(* IH for subtrees *)
544	have IHl' := IHl Hvl Huniq_l.
545	have IHr' := IHr Hvr Huniq_r.
546	(* Size facts *)
547	have Hsz_s : size s = size sl + 1 + size sr.
548	  by rewrite /s size_cat /= addnS addn1 addSn.
549	have Hs_ne : s <> [::].
550	  by rewrite /s; case: (sl) => [|??]; discriminate.
551	(* 3-way case split on i vs size sl *)
552	case: (ltngtP i (size sl)) => [Hij | Hji | Heq_ij].
553	(* ==== Case i < size sl: recurse on left subtree ==== *)
554	- have [P1l [P2l [P3l [P4l P5l]]]] := IHl' i.
555	  split; [|split; [|split; [|split]]].
556	  + (* P1: post-window extremum *)
557	    move=> Hpost.
558	    rewrite (wa_bridge_left Hmm Hij)
559	            (ws_bridge_left Hmm Hij) in Hpost *.
560	    have Hij' : i < mm_pos s by rewrite Hmm.
561	    have Hfit := window_fits_left Hs_ne Hij'.
562	    rewrite Hmm (ws_bridge_left Hmm Hij) in Hfit.
563	    set ws_l := window_size i sl.
564	    case Hbnd : (i + ws_l < size sl).
565	    * (* Window fits inside left subtree *)
566	      have Hpost_l : i + ws_l < size sl := Hbnd.
567	      have := P1l Hpost_l.
568	      by rewrite nth_cat Hbnd.
569	    * (* Window reaches boundary: post-window element is x *)
570	      have Hfit2 : i + ws_l = size sl.
571	        move/negbT: Hbnd; rewrite -leqNgt => Hge.
572	        by apply/eqP; rewrite eqn_leq Hge Hfit.
573	      rewrite Hfit2.
574	      have Hnth_j := nth_w_mm_pos Hs_ne.
575	      set wa := window_at i sl.
576	      have Hsz_sl : size sl <= size s.
577	        by rewrite Hsz_s; apply: leq_trans (leq_addr _ _) (leq_addr _ _).
578	      have Hws_gt0 : 0 < ws_l.
579	        by apply: window_size_gt0; exact: Hij.
580	      have Hwa_ne : wa <> [::].
581	        move=> Hab.
582	        have Hsz0 : size wa = 0 by rewrite Hab.
583	        have Hsz_wa : size wa = ws_l.
584	          rewrite /wa /window_at size_takel //.
585	          by rewrite size_drop; exact: window_size_bound.
586	        by move: Hws_gt0; rewrite -Hsz_wa Hsz0.
587	      have Hwa_sub : {subset wa <= sl}.
588	        move=> y; rewrite /wa /window_at => Hy.
589	        have := mem_take Hy; exact: mem_drop.
590	      have [Hno_min Hno_max] := notin_take_mm Hs_ne.
591	      have Hmin_sort := min_eq_nth_sort_0 Hwa_ne.
592	      have Hmax_sort := max_eq_nth_sort_last Hwa_ne.
593	      have Hwa_sub_sl : {subset wa <= take (size sl) s}.
594	        move=> y Hy; rewrite (take_mm_eq Hmm).
595	        exact: Hwa_sub.
596	      set minwa := foldr minn (head 0 wa) (behead wa).
597	      set maxwa := foldr maxn (head 0 wa) (behead wa).
598	      have Hminwa_in : minwa \in wa.
599	        by rewrite /minwa; case: (wa) Hwa_ne =>
600	          [//|b t] _ /=; exact: min_in.
601	      have Hmaxwa_in : maxwa \in wa.
602	        by rewrite /maxwa; case: (wa) Hwa_ne =>
603	          [//|b t] _ /=; exact: max_in.
604	      have Hsz_wa : size wa = ws_l.
605	        rewrite /wa /window_at size_takel //.
606	        by rewrite size_drop; exact: window_size_bound.
607	      case: Hnth_j; rewrite -/s Hmm => Hval.
608	      -- left.
609	         rewrite /s nth_cat ltnn /= Hval -Hmin_sort.
610	         have Hminwa_le :
611	           foldr minn (head 0 s) (behead s) <= minwa.
612	           apply: foldr_minn_le.
613	           have := Hwa_sub_sl _ Hminwa_in.
614	           exact: mem_take.
615	         have Hminwa_ne :
616	           foldr minn (head 0 s) (behead s) != minwa.
617	           apply/negP => /eqP Heq_v.
618	           have : foldr minn (head 0 s) (behead s)
619	             \in take (size sl) s
620	             by rewrite Heq_v; exact: Hwa_sub_sl.
621	           by rewrite (negbTE Hno_min).
622	         by rewrite ltn_neqAle Hminwa_ne Hminwa_le.
623	      -- right.
624	         have Hmaxwa_le :
625	           maxwa <= foldr maxn (head 0 s) (behead s).
626	           apply: foldr_maxn_ge.
627	           have := Hwa_sub_sl _ Hmaxwa_in.
628	           exact: mem_take.
629	         have Hmaxwa_ne :
630	           maxwa != foldr maxn (head 0 s) (behead s).
631	           apply/negP => /eqP Heq_v.
632	           have : foldr maxn (head 0 s) (behead s)
633	             \in take (size sl) s
634	             by rewrite -Heq_v; exact: Hwa_sub_sl.
635	           by rewrite (negbTE Hno_max).
636	         have Hmaxwa_eq :
637	           nth 0 (sort leq wa) (ws_l.-1) = maxwa.
638	           have -> : ws_l.-1 = (size wa).-1
639	             by rewrite Hsz_wa.
640	           by rewrite -Hmax_sort.

Lemma test_nth_drop (sl sr : seq nat) (x : nat)
  (s := sl ++ x :: sr) (i' : nat) :

  drop j.+1 s = sr ->
  i'.-1 + j.+1 = (i' + j.+1).-1 ->
  0 < i' ->
  nth 0 s (i' + j.+1).-1 = nth 0 sr i'.-1.

move=> /= Hdrop Hpred Hi0.
by rewrite -[RHS]/(nth 0 (drop (size sl).+1 s) i'.-1)
   Hdrop.
